basis: Configuration-specific design analysis for the independent PETG bridge; no physical measurements or fabrication authority

allowance_basis.height_setting: Included in the combined datum/setting/measurement uncertainty; do not count twice
allowance_basis.setup_repeatability: 0.15 mm retainer play plus 4.0 mm whole-fixture angular approach; carrier plane <=3 degrees, combined optical-axis error <=6 degrees
allowance_basis.fixture_approach: 1.0053 mm analytical structure/joint approach rounded upward; E=500 N/mm2 is an assumption
allowance_basis.cable_approach: Cable force already included in the structural load case; no separate credit for unsupported cables
allowance_basis.dut_approach: Maximum permitted upward device/cradle movement; must be established on the actual setup
allowance_basis.gap_measurement_uncertainty: Proposed 2 mm combined method bound, subject to demonstrated alignment and repeatability
allowance_basis.other_projection: 28 mm bounds the modeled carrier saddle head and supported service loop; shroud remains closest at 30 mm
